critical_code_review_comments: String-comparison of ISO timestamps in list_customers works because all times are UTC ISO from datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() — safe as long as everyone keeps stamping via helpers. Any code that inserts a message with a naive local ISO string would break the ordering silently. Consider comparing parsed datetimes for robustness.
server.py is now >1500 lines and mixes many resource routers — consider splitting into router modules (customers.py, messages.py, etc). Non-blocking.
